description: This file defines a Grain class for Orleans that subscribes to a stream with implicit subscription, handles stream events, manages fault injection for testing error recovery, and reports progress. It includes stream subscription setup, event processing with duplicate detection, fault injection logic, and state management.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscription_NonTransientError_RecoverableStream_CollectorGrain
classes.description: A Grain class that subscribes to an Orleans stream with implicit subscription, processes incoming events, manages fault injection for testing error handling, and reports progress.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the grain, reads state, sets up stream subscription.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming stream events, manages duplicate detection, fault injection, checkpointing, and reporting.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles stream errors, clears fault state.

methods.name: InjectFault
methods.description: Simulates a fault by throwing an exception to test error recovery.
